messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 12 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The DMS (iManage) will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 12 April until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before you leave on Friday. Email will be unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk
